Bug_Explanation: The method changeCondition() uses notify() instead of notifyAll(). This can result in only one of multiple waiting threads being notified, leaving the others potentially blocked indefinitely. Using notifyAll() would ensure that all waiting threads are notified.
Trigger_Explanation: The testShowBug method calls the showBug method in NotifyDemo. This method starts two threads that wait for a condition to be met and then calls changeCondition. Since changeCondition uses notify() instead of notifyAll(), only one of the threads is notified. The other thread remains blocked indefinitely, causing the test to fail.
